name: Butler University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2026-27 tuition ($50,860) + fees ($990) = $51,850 from butler.edu/admission-aid/tuition-costs/. Housing is only published as combined 'Housing and Food' (room + board) at $17,730, based on average double room and full meal plan for first-year students; room-only not separately published.
